---
title: "Membership"
---

Membership of SBF is open to everyone who works in or is interested in behavioural medicine: researchers, clinicians, PhD students and students, including international colleagues based in Sweden.

## As a member you get

- invitations to the society's lunch talks and other activities
- a newsletter with conferences, funding calls and courses
- a network of colleagues across disciplines
- a say in the society's activities through the annual meeting
